items.rationale: Sections 2.3.3 and 4.2.2 cover a fixed AC unit if the fire group was taken and the surge was caused by lightning or other atmospheric electricity; neither is confirmed. This wording has no kitchen exclusion, so the conditional estimate is €1,400 gross for a like-for-like unit under §§7.1.9–7.1.10.

Under §§7.1.1 and 7.1.11, necessary installation and connection checks follow the covered replacement. Allow €480 gross for one standard installation, subject to itemisation under §9.5 if the line also includes unrelated work.

The pre-loss floor-standing arrangement does not establish that the console itself needed replacement. Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.9 exclude an elective new support; allow €61 gross if a like-for-like console was necessary to reinstate the covered unit.
Section 7.1.11 allows ordinary freight only in proportion to the covered replacement parts shipped. Allow €43 gross for the covered shipment, excluding any share attributable to unrelated equipment.
